description: This file is the main entry point for a React project, initializing and rendering the root React component (`<App />`) within a router context (`BrowserRouter`). It sets up the DOM container and renders the application wrapped with routing capabilities.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to manage a React application rendering in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot().render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the DOM managed by ReactDOM.
